title: Advanced Java & Backend Engineering — Readiness Check
description: Twenty questions spanning all ten modules of Advanced Java & Backend Engineering. Available independently of course enrollment.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: What evidence helps diagnose many threads waiting on a lock?

options.text: Thread dumps and lock-related runtime events
An image of the source tree

questions.explanation: Thread state and lock ownership point to contention.

questions.prompt: Is process memory identical to the live Java heap?
questions.explanation: Native allocations, stacks, reserved memory, and other runtime structures also matter.

questions.prompt: What can reduce synchronization needs?

options.text: Confining mutable state to one thread

questions.explanation: Unshared state eliminates cross-thread races on that state.

questions.prompt: How should a translated InterruptedException usually be handled?

options.text: Restore the interrupt flag or propagate the interruption

questions.explanation: Cancellation should remain observable to the caller.

questions.prompt: Why can a fixed worker pool still run out of memory?

options.text: An unbounded queue can accumulate pending tasks
Every fixed pool starts infinite workers

questions.explanation: Worker limits do not imply queue or admission limits.

questions.prompt: Does the sample’s output reveal which task finished first?
questions.explanation: The caller explicitly combines results in a chosen order.

questions.prompt: Should required labs silently depend on preview syntax?
questions.explanation: Preview features need explicit opt-in and compatibility treatment.

questions.prompt: What does exports primarily expose?

options.text: Public API types in a package under module access rules

questions.explanation: Normal API access and reflective openness are distinct.

questions.prompt: Why bound an API page size?

options.text: To control resource use and response size

questions.explanation: Unbounded collection requests can exhaust application and database capacity.

questions.prompt: Why is renaming a response field a compatibility decision?

options.text: External clients may depend on its name

questions.explanation: Public contracts extend beyond the service source tree.

questions.prompt: Should database integration tests use the production database family?

options.text: No, every SQL dialect is identical
Only if there are no migrations

questions.explanation: Dialect and transaction differences can matter.

questions.prompt: Does @Transactional imply the strongest isolation level automatically?
questions.explanation: Isolation depends on transaction configuration and database defaults.

questions.prompt: What is appropriate for stored password verification?
questions.explanation: Password verification needs a purpose-built password hashing scheme.

questions.prompt: Which item should be excluded from routine logs?
questions.explanation: Tokens are credentials and must not leak through logs.

questions.prompt: Which checks belong in a creation endpoint contract test?

options.text: Only that no exception was printed
Only the exact private call count
Status, Location, response fields, and persistence effect

questions.explanation: Contract tests assert observable behavior at the chosen boundary.

questions.prompt: Why keep full application tests selective?

options.text: They always replace all unit tests
They cost more and should cover distinct integration risks

questions.explanation: Balance broad wiring confidence with fast focused feedback.

questions.prompt: What problem can retries at several layers cause?

options.text: Multiplicative load on a failing dependency

questions.explanation: Nested retry loops amplify attempts.

questions.prompt: Does the sample HashSet deduplication survive a process restart?
questions.explanation: Durability requires persistent state and an atomic effect policy.

questions.prompt: What is a safer schema rollout for a field rename used by old clients?

options.text: Silently change all response fields at once
An additive compatible transition followed by deliberate removal

questions.explanation: Compatibility windows allow clients and application versions to transition.

questions.prompt: Does passing a multiple-choice quiz prove operational readiness alone?
questions.explanation: Projects, debugging evidence, and practical operation demonstrate additional skills.
